arguments:
{"code":"local floor = math.floor
local function clamp(x, lo, hi)
  if x < lo then return lo end
  if x > hi then return hi end
  return x
end
local ELEM = {
  physical = {fire = 100, water = 100, nature = 100, neutral = 100, ghost = 0},
  fire = {fire = 50, water = 50, nature = 200, neutral = 100, ghost = 100},
  water = {fire = 200, water = 50, nature = 50, neutral = 100, ghost = 100},
  nature = {fire = 50, water = 200, nature = 50, neutral = 100, ghost = 100}
}
local resolve_fn = function(attacker, defender, skill)
  attacker = attacker or {}
  defender = defender or {}
  skill = skill or {}
  local atk = attacker.atk or 0
  local a_level = attacker.level or 0
  local crit_chance = attacker.crit_chance or 0
  local crit_mult = attacker.crit_mult or 150
  local pen_pct = attacker.pen_pct or 0
  local pen_flat = attacker.pen_flat or 0
  local start_hp = defender.hp or 1
  local hp = start_hp
  local shield = defender.shield or 0
  local armor = defender.armor or 0
  local d_level = defender.level or 0
  local d_element = defender.element or 'neutral'
  local resist = defender.resist or {}
  local guarding = defender.guarding or false
  local power = skill.power or 0
  local s_element = skill.element or 'physical'
  local hits = skill.hits or 1
  local true_damage = skill.true_damage or false
  local seed = skill.seed or 0
  local row = ELEM[s_element] or ELEM.physical
  local m = row[d_element] or 100
  local absorbed, crits, resolved, overkill, killed = 0, 0, 0, 0, false
  for k = 1, hits do
    local p = math.max(10, power - 20 * (k - 1))
    local d = floor(atk * p / 100)
    local diff = clamp(a_level - d_level, -10, 10)
    d = floor(d * (100 + 3 * diff) / 100)
    local crit = (seed + 17 * k) % 100 < crit_chance
    if crit then d = floor(d * crit_mult / 100) end
    local immune = false
    if not true_damage then
      local pen = pen_pct
      if crit then pen = pen * 2 end
      pen = math.min(pen, 100)
      local ea = math.max(0, floor(armor * (100 - pen) / 100) - pen_flat)
      d = floor(d * 100 / (100 + ea))
      d = floor(d * m / 100)
      local r = clamp(resist[s_element] or 0, -50, 80)
      d = floor(d * (100 - r) / 100)
      immune = (m == 0)
    end
    if guarding then d = floor(d / 2) end
    if d < 1 and not immune then d = 1 end
    local a = math.min(shield, d)
    shield = shield - a
    local loss = d - a
    if a > 0 and shield == 0 then loss = floor(loss * 125 / 100) end
    absorbed = absorbed + a
    resolved = resolved + 1
    if crit then crits = crits + 1 end
    if loss >= hp then
      overkill = loss - hp
      hp = 0
      killed = true
      break
    end
    hp = hp - loss
  end
  return {damage = start_hp - hp, absorbed = absorbed, hp = hp, shield = shield, overkill = overkill, crits = crits, hits = resolved, killed = killed}
end
local function fmt(r)
  return 'damage=' .. tostring(r.damage) .. ' absorbed=' .. tostring(r.absorbed) .. ' hp=' .. tostring(r.hp) .. ' shield=' .. tostring(r.shield) .. ' overkill=' .. tostring(r.overkill) .. ' crits=' .. tostring(r.crits) .. ' hits=' .. tostring(r.hits) .. ' killed=' .. tostring(r.killed)
end
local e1 = 'damage=60 absorbed=10 hp=0 shield=0 overkill=57 crits=1 hits=1 killed=true'
local e2 = 'damage=137 absorbed=25 hp=163 shield=0 overkill=0 crits=0 hits=3 killed=false'
local s1 = fmt(resolve_fn({atk=40, level=12, crit_chance=30, crit_mult=150, pen_pct=25, pen_flat=5}, {hp=60, shield=10, armor=40, level=10, element='nature', resist={fire=20}, guarding=false}, {power=120, element='fire', hits=2, true_damage=false, seed=3}))
local s2 = fmt(resolve_fn({atk=90, level=3, crit_chance=50, crit_mult=200, pen_pct=40, pen_flat=10}, {hp=300, shield=25, armor=60, level=20, element='fire', resist={water=-30}, guarding=true}, {power=100, element='water', hits=3, true_damage=false, seed=40}))
logic_define('resolve_attack', resolve_fn)
return 'ex1 ' .. (s1 == e1 and 'PASS' or 'FAIL') .. ' ' .. s1 .. ' | ex2 ' .. (s2 == e2 and 'PASS' or 'FAIL') .. ' ' .. s2 .. ' | resolve_attack registered'"}

arguments:
{"code":"logic_define('nearest_tower', function(name)
  if type(name) ~= 'string' then return 'none' end
  local s = coreai_world_pos(name)
  if s == nil then return 'none' end
  local dist = {}
  local dmin = nil
  for k = 1, 8 do
    local p = coreai_world_pos('Tower' .. k)
    if p ~= nil then
      local dx = p.x - s.x
      local dz = p.z - s.z
      dist[k] = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
      if dmin == nil or dist[k] < dmin then dmin = dist[k] end
    end
  end
  if dmin == nil then return 'none' end
  for k = 1, 8 do
    if dist[k] ~= nil and dist[k] <= 1.01 * dmin then return 'Tower' .. k end
  end
  return 'none'
end)
logic_define('wall_for_bearing', function(b)
  if type(b) == 'string' then b = tonumber(b) end
  if type(b) ~= 'number' or b ~= b or b == math.huge or b == -math.huge then return 'none' end
  b = b % 360
  if b >= 360 then b = 0 end
  local half = math.atan2(1.5, 15 * math.cos(22.5 * math.pi / 180)) * 180 / math.pi
  local gates = { { 'Gate_North', 347.5 }, { 'Gate_South', 167.5 } }
  for i = 1, 2 do
    local diff = math.abs(b - gates[i][2])
    if diff > 180 then diff = 360 - diff end
    if diff <= half then return gates[i][1] end
  end
  local b2 = b
  if b2 < 10 then b2 = b2 + 360 end
  local k = 8
  for i = 1, 8 do
    local tb = 10 + 45 * (i - 1)
    if b2 >= tb and b2 < tb + 45 then k = i end
  end
  return 'Wall' .. k
end)"}

name: execute_lua
arguments:
{"code":"local dirs = {{-1, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, -1}, {0, 1}}
local function has(m, bit) return math.floor(m / bit) % 2 == 1 end
local function landOk(ch, m)
  if ch == '' or ch == '#' then return false end
  if ch == 'A' then return has(m, 1) end
  if ch == 'B' then return has(m, 2) end
  return true
end
local function oneWayOk(ch, dr, dc)
  if ch == '>' then return dr == 0 and dc == 1 end
  if ch == '<' then return dr == 0 and dc == -1 end
  if ch == '^' then return dr == -1 and dc == 0 end
  if ch == 'v' then return dr == 1 and dc == 0 end
  return true
end
local function pick(ch, m)
  if ch == 'a' and not has(m, 1) then return m + 1 end
  if ch == 'b' and not has(m, 2) then return m + 2 end
  return m
end
local function route(grid, teleporters)
  teleporters = teleporters or {}
  local R = #grid
  local C = #grid[1]
  local cells, sr, sc, gr, gc = {}, nil, nil, nil, nil
  for r = 1, R do
    cells[r] = {}
    for c = 1, C do
      local ch = string.sub(grid[r], c, c)
      cells[r][c] = ch
      if ch == 'S' then sr, sc = r, c end
      if ch == 'G' then gr, gc = r, c end
    end
  end
  if not sr or not gr then return {cost = -1, actions = -1} end
  local function enc(r, c, m) return ((r - 1) * C + (c - 1)) * 4 + m + 1 end
  local cost, acts, done, open = {}, {}, {}, {}
  local function relax(id, nc, na)
    if done[id] then return end
    if cost[id] == nil then
      cost[id], acts[id] = nc, na
      open[#open + 1] = id
    elseif nc < cost[id] or (nc == cost[id] and na < acts[id]) then
      cost[id], acts[id] = nc, na
    end
  end
  local s = enc(sr, sc, 0)
  cost[s], acts[s] = 0, 0
  open[1] = s
  while #open > 0 do
    local bi, bid = 1, open[1]
    for i = 2, #open do
      local id = open[i]
      if cost[id] < cost[bid] or (cost[id] == cost[bid] and acts[id] < acts[bid]) then
        bi, bid = i, id
      end
    end
    open[bi] = open[#open]
    open[#open] = nil
    done[bid] = true
    local id0 = bid - 1
    local m = id0 % 4
    local cell = (id0 - m) / 4
    local r = math.floor(cell / C) + 1
    local c = cell - (r - 1) * C + 1
    local cc, aa = cost[bid], acts[bid]
    if cells[r][c] == 'G' then return {cost = cc, actions = aa} end
    for k = 1, 4 do
      local dr, dc = dirs[k][1], dirs[k][2]
      local nr, nc = r + dr, c + dc
      if nr >= 1 and nr <= R and nc >= 1 and nc <= C then
        local ch = cells[nr][nc]
        if landOk(ch, m) and oneWayOk(ch, dr, dc) then
          local step = 1
          if ch == '~' then step = 3 end
          relax(enc(nr, nc, pick(ch, m)), cc + step, aa + 1)
        end
      end
    end
    for _, t in ipairs(teleporters) do
      if t.fr == r and t.fc == c then
        local ch = cells[t.tr][t.tc]
        if landOk(ch, m) then
          relax(enc(t.tr, t.tc, pick(ch, m)), cc + t.cost, aa + 1)
        end
      end
    end
  end
  return {cost = -1, actions = -1}
end
local function check(name, grid, tp, ec, ea)
  local r = route(grid, tp)
  local ok = r.cost == ec and r.actions == ea
  return name .. (ok and ' ok' or (' FAIL got cost=' .. tostring(r.cost) .. ' actions=' .. tostring(r.actions)))
end
local out = {
  check('e1', {'S~G', '...'}, {}, 4, 2),
  check('e2', {'S.A.G', '#.###', 'a....'}, {}, 10, 10),
  check('e3a', {'S#G', '.#.', '...'}, {{fr=1, fc=1, tr=1, tc=3, cost=5}}, 5, 1),
  check('e3b', {'S#G', '.#.', '...'}, {{fr=1, fc=1, tr=1, tc=3, cost=7}}, 6, 6),
  check('e4', {'S<G', '...'}, {}, 4, 4),
}
logic_define('route', route)
return table.concat(out, '; ')"}

execute_lua
arguments:
{"code":"local S = nil
local function mk(u, side)
return {id = u.id, side = side, hp = u.hp, max_hp = u.hp, atk = u.atk, def = u.def, spd = u.spd, skill = u.skill, cd = u.cd, shield = 0, poison = 0, stun = 0, cooldown = 0}
end
local function hit(U, T)
local dmg = U.atk - T.def
if dmg < 1 then dmg = 1 end
local a = math.min(T.shield, dmg)
T.shield = T.shield - a
T.hp = T.hp - (dmg - a)
if T.hp <= 0 then T.hp = 0; return false end
return true
end
local function pick_enemy(U)
local best = nil
for _, r in ipairs(S.recs) do
if r.side ~= U.side and r.hp > 0 then
if best == nil then best = r else
local k, bk = r.hp + r.shield, best.hp + best.shield
if k < bk or (k == bk and (r.hp < best.hp or (r.hp == best.hp and r.id < best.id))) then best = r end
end
end
end
return best
end
local function pick_low_ally(U)
local best = nil
for _, r in ipairs(S.recs) do
if r.side == U.side and r.hp > 0 then
if best == nil or r.hp < best.hp or (r.hp == best.hp and r.id < best.id) then best = r end
end
end
return best
end
local function pick_hurt_ally(U)
local best = nil
for _, r in ipairs(S.recs) do
if r.side == U.side and r.hp > 0 then
if best == nil then best = r else
local d, bd = r.max_hp - r.hp, best.max_hp - best.hp
if d > bd or (d == bd and r.id < best.id) then best = r end
end
end
end
return best
end
local function use_skill(U)
local sk = U.skill
if sk == 'poison' or sk == 'stun' then
local T = pick_enemy(U)
if T ~= nil and hit(U, T) then
if sk == 'poison' then T.poison = math.min(6, T.poison + 2) else T.stun = 1 end
end
elseif sk == 'cleave' then
local targets = {}
for _, r in ipairs(S.recs) do
if r.side ~= U.side and r.hp > 0 then targets[#targets + 1] = r end
end
for _, T in ipairs(targets) do hit(U, T) end
elseif sk == 'shield' then
local A = pick_low_ally(U)
if A ~= nil then A.shield = math.min(20, A.shield + 2 * U.atk) end
elseif sk == 'heal' then
local A = pick_hurt_ally(U)
if A ~= nil then A.hp = math.min(A.max_hp, A.hp + 2 * U.atk) end
end
end
local function turn(U)
if U.poison > 0 then
U.hp = U.hp - U.poison
U.poison = U.poison - 1
if U.hp <= 0 then U.hp = 0; return end
end
if U.cooldown > 0 then U.cooldown = U.cooldown - 1 end
if U.stun > 0 then U.stun = U.stun - 1; return end
if U.skill ~= 'none' and U.cooldown == 0 then
use_skill(U)
U.cooldown = U.cd
else
local T = pick_enemy(U)
if T ~= nil then hit(U, T) end
end
end
local function new_round()
S.round = S.round + 1
if S.round > 20 then S.result = 'draw'; return false end
local alive = {}
for _, r in ipairs(S.recs) do
if r.hp > 0 then alive[#alive + 1] = r end
end
table.sort(alive, function(x, y)
if x.spd ~= y.spd then return x.spd > y.spd end
if x.hp ~= y.hp then return x.hp > y.hp end
return x.id < y.id
end)
S.order = alive
S.pos = 0
return #alive > 0
end
local function next_actor()
while true do
while S.pos < #S.order do
S.pos = S.pos + 1
local r = S.order[S.pos]
if r.hp > 0 then return r end
end
if not new_round() then return nil end
end
end
local function check_end()
local na, nb = 0, 0
for _, r in ipairs(S.recs) do
if r.hp > 0 then
if r.side == 'A' then na = na + 1 else nb = nb + 1 end
end
end
if na == 0 and nb == 0 then S.result = 'draw'
elseif na == 0 then S.result = 'B'
elseif nb == 0 then S.result = 'A' end
end
local function battle_step()
if S == nil or S.result ~= 'running' then return 'end' end
local U = next_actor()
if U == nil then check_end(); return 'end' end
turn(U)
check_end()
return U.id
end
local function battle_start(team_a, team_b)
S = {recs = {}, byid = {}, order = {}, pos = 0, round = 0, result = 'running'}
for _, u in ipairs(team_a or {}) do
local r = mk(u, 'A')
S.recs[#S.recs + 1] = r
S.byid[r.id] = r
end
for _, u in ipairs(team_b or {}) do
local r = mk(u, 'B')
S.recs[#S.recs + 1] = r
S.byid[r.id] = r
end
return true
end
local function unit_state(id)
local r = nil
if S ~= nil then r = S.byid[id] end
if r == nil then return {hp = 0, shield = 0, poison = 0, stun = 0, cooldown = 0} end
return {hp = r.hp, shield = r.shield, poison = r.poison, stun = r.stun, cooldown = r.cooldown}
end
local function battle_result()
if S == nil then return 'running' end
return S.result
end
local function fmt(s) return tostring(s.hp) .. '/' .. tostring(s.shield) .. '/' .. tostring(s.poison) .. '/' .. tostring(s.stun) .. '/' .. tostring(s.cooldown) end
local out = {}
battle_start({{id = 'A1', hp = 20, atk = 6, def = 1, spd = 5, skill = 'poison', cd = 2}}, {{id = 'B1', hp = 18, atk = 5, def = 2, spd = 5, skill = 'stun', cd = 3}})
for i = 1, 5 do out[#out + 1] = battle_step() end
local seq = ''

local function roomNames()

  for _, L in ipairs(LETTERS) do

local function roomOf(name)
  if type(name) ~= 'string' or not coreai_world_exists(name) then return 'none' end
  local o = coreai_world_pos(name)
  if o == nil then return 'none' end
  local cand, minD = {}, nil
  for _, rn in ipairs(roomNames()) do
    local c = coreai_world_pos(rn)
    if c ~= nil then
      local dx, dz = o.x - c.x, o.z - c.z
      local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
      table.insert(cand, {n = rn, d = d})
      if minD == nil or d < minD then minD = d end
    end
  end
  if minD == nil then return 'none' end
  for _, e in ipairs(cand) do
    if e.d <= 1.01 * minD + 1e-9 then return e.n end
  end
  return 'none'
end

local function parseDoor(n)
  if type(n) ~= 'string' then return nil end
  local p, q, c = string.match(n, '^Door_([A-I])_([A-I])_(%a+)$')
  if p == nil then
    p, q = string.match(n, '^Door_([A-I])_([A-I])$')
    c = 'open'
  end
  if p == nil or p == q then return nil end
  if c ~= 'open' and c ~= 'Red' and c ~= 'Blue' and c ~= 'Gold' then return nil end
  return p, q, c

local function heldHas(inv, c)
  if type(inv) ~= 'string' then return false end
  return string.find(',' .. inv .. ',', ',' .. c .. ',', 1, true) ~= nil
end

local function doorOpens(c, inv)
  if c == 'open' then return true end
  return heldHas(inv, c) or heldHas(inv, 'Gold')
end

local function doorEdges()
  local out = {}
  for _, dn in ipairs(coreai_world_find('Door_') or {}) do
    local p, q, c = parseDoor(dn)
    if p ~= nil and coreai_world_exists(dn) then

local function distancesFrom(start, inv)
  local edges = doorEdges()
  local dist, queue, head = {[start] = 0}, {start}, 1
  while head <= #queue do
    local cur = queue[head]

    for _, e in ipairs(edges) do

local function parseInv(inv)

local function stateKey(room, h)

local function minDoorsToExit(inv)
